decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to deal with threats on the board. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Bloodthirsty Adversary and Voldaren Epicure to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. Additionally, cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Claim / Fame provide additional value and versatility. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the game through disruption and aggression.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive spells like Elite Spellbinder. Collected Company is a powerful card that allows the player to put multiple creatures onto the battlefield at once, further overwhelming the opponent. The deck includes strong aggressive creatures like Luminarch Aspirant and Thalia's Lieutenant to push for early damage and pressure the opponent. Mutavault provides additional creature threats, while Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts noncreature spells, allowing the deck to maintain tempo and control the board.

The main concept of this deck is to have a fast and aggressive playstyle with a focus on creatures that have synergy with each other. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures such as Luminarch Aspirant and Thalia's Lieutenant, backed up by disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Dire Tactics. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and resilience to the deck's strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive game plan and ensure consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures with heroic abilities and spells that boost their power and protect them. It aims to aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Tenth District Legionnaire, supported by spells like Boros Charm and Gods Willing. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for consistent card advantage and the ability to replay key creatures from the graveyard. The deck is built to quickly pressure the opponent and maintain board control through efficient spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently to power out Jeskai Ascendancy and combo off with spells like Treasure Cruise and Sylvan Awakening. It also includes Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion to provide a backup plan and additional mana ramp. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and creatures while maintaining control with cards like Mystical Dispute and Portable Hole. It utilizes a mix of different lands to ensure it has access to the right colors of mana needed to execute its game plan effectively.

The focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Favored Hoplite, using spells like Titan's Strength, Boros Charm, and Gird for Battle to pump them up and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes combat tricks and protection spells like Gods Willing and Defiant Strike to protect your creatures and ensure they can get through for damage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows you to play small creatures from your graveyard, helping to maintain pressure on your opponent.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes versatile removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to control the board and clear the way for attacks. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet provide additional value and threats to the opponent. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this Jund Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana with mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Gilded Goose, summon powerful creatures like Korvold and Catacomb Sifter, and utilize cards like Mayhem Devil and Priest of Forgotten Gods to deal damage to the opponent while gaining card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Collected Company and Bolas's Citadel to help maintain board presence and close out games quickly. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful combo pieces, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient game plan.

The main concept of the deck is to use low-cost, aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Tenth District Legionnaire, Monastery Swiftspear, and Favored Hoplite in combination with combat tricks like Boros Charm and Gods Willing, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value from the graveyard, enhancing the deck's ability to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and efficient instant spells that boost their power. The key strategy is to maintain a strong board presence while protecting your creatures from removal and enabling them to deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional resilience and versatility to the deck. The deck aims to consistently apply pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Jeskai Ascendancy alongside creatures such as Paradise Druid and Sylvan Caryatid to generate mana and activate powerful abilities. The deck also includes cards like Treasure Cruise and Expressive Iteration to dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage. Additional cards like Sylvan Awakening and Chained to the Rocks provide additional utility and removal options. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The main concept of this Pioneer Aggro deck centered around Arclight Phoenix is to quickly cycle through spells to fill the graveyard with Phoenixes and flip Thing in the Ice, allowing for explosive damage output. The deck features a mix of card draw, cantrips, and removal spells to enable consistent and powerful plays. The inclusion of Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise adds additional ways to refill the hand and efficiently bring back the Phoenixes. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher late game, while maintaining a mana base that enables smooth casting of spells.

This Red Deck Wins Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck focuses on aggressive play and dealing damage quickly to the opponent. It includes cards like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Goblin Chainwhirler to provide powerful threats and board control. The deck also features burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to finish off opponents or clear blockers. With efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Eidolon of the Great Revel, this deck aims to pressure opponents early and close out games before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful creature strategy. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and The Book of Exalted Deeds, the deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with impactful creatures such as Archon of Emeria, Resplendent Angel, and Skyclave Apparition. The deck also benefits from lifegain synergies with cards like Righteous Valkyrie and Speaker of the Heavens, while utilizing dual lands and color fixing to ensure a consistent mana base for aggressive plays.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on using powerful vampires and efficient removal to apply pressure on the opponent and control the board. With a strong curve of creatures like Knight of the Ebon Legion and Gifted Aetherborn, supplemented by powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Sorin the Mirthless, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily chipping away at their life total. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide crucial disruption and removal, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive strategy and achieve victory through a combination of board presence and direct damage.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to utilize low-cost, efficient creatures and combat tricks to rapidly apply pressure to the opponent. With a focus on cards that can provide extra damage, protection, and card advantage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly before they can stabilize. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional creature recursion and value over the course of the game. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to be aggressive and relentless in attacking the opponent while maintaining card advantage and protection for key creatures.
